summary: Anthropic announced that future Claude models will embed a SynthID-style text watermark to comply with the EU AI Act's Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content, alongside a private-preview detection API and C2PA content credentials for generated files.

practices.reason: A new detection API and content-credential metadata are being introduced, which teams with EU compliance obligations would need to integrate, though access is currently limited to eligible organizations.
